[S1852 done] tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1852CoherentCoverActual.lean  (EXIT=0, no sorry, no new axiom)

EVIDENCE
- source: 31153 bytes, SHA256 50D415E1DA8D3D46F8808DD48806E6F283A170ECC29D7C43C51821131F3FB429
- olean : .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1852CoherentCoverActual.olean
          453272 bytes, SHA256 34ED66AEFBAAB90CB8B53C4E8A518D3D4563E169C761A2E10ECFE3165FA3EE25
- build : lake env lean -j1 -R D:\lean -o <olean> <file>  -> LEAN_EXIT=0, zero errors/warnings
- axioms: 28 #print axioms entries, ALL = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorryAx.
- independent re-check: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1852ArtifactCheck.lean imports the compiled
  olean, re-proves the main statements from it, CHECK_EXIT=0 (same axiom trio).

WHAT IT BUILDS (no existing definition modified; all new structures)
1. S1852WeakSquare: the square of any EtaleStackBaseChangePresentation; at the identity
   point it is S1743Square by rfl (S1852WeakSquare_S1743).
2. S1852ConeEssSurj P (general over F, ALL test schemes/points): the FULL 2-universal
   property = essential surjectivity of the cone comparison Hom(W,P)->Cone(W) on 1-cells
   (1-cell with matching projections is 2-iso to the cone's lift). At the identity point it
   is literally S1784LiftEssSurj/S1827ConeEssSurj (Iff.rfl), so
   S1852ConeEssSurj_iff_unit : ... <-> S1756Unit A, and ..._iff_end : ... <-> S1756End A = 1.
3. StrongEtaleStackBaseChangePresentation := weak presentation + coneEssSurj.
   StrongEtaleStackFiniteEtaleMorphism := strong presentation at every (T,q) + finite/etale
   projection; forgetful toWeak with toWeak.baseChange = (strong).toWeak (rfl), so the
   identity-point weak presentation is syntactically the same term.
4. StrongCover + CoherentCover (CoherentCover has the S1756Unit FIELD,
   unit : S1756Unit (StrongCover.cover toStrongCover)); CoherentCover.ofStrong DERIVES the
   unit from the strong structure (S1852Unit_of_strong) - it is not assumed.
   S1852FirstMissingOnCoherent : forall coherent A, S1756End A.cover = 1 (S1733Model A.cover);
   S1852FirstMissingOnCoherent_viaStrong reproves it from the full 2-universal property
   alone (no use of the unit field).
5. Identity/terminal cover: S1852IdStrongBc proves the full 2-universal property of the
   canonical identity-point square (S1762IdBaseChange) at EVERY test scheme and point
   (lift = cone.toY, comparisons by right unitor); S1852IdStrong : strong finite etale id;
   S1852TerminalStrong / S1852TerminalCoherent, with S1852TerminalModel : model = S1726AffineOver
   by rfl, S1852TerminalEnd = identity. Nonempty CoherentCover.
6. EXACT FIRST MISSING: S1852FirstMissing := forall A, S1852ConeEssSurj (S1743BaseChange A).
   S1852FirstMissing_iff_S1756 : <-> S1756FirstMissing. S1852NotFirstMissing :
   not S1852FirstMissing (transported from S1850_not_firstMissing). So the strong datum is
   strictly stronger than the recorded one.
7. THE STRENGTHENING EXCLUDES S1850's COUNTEREXAMPLE: over the doubled square the cone
   (q, id) has BOTH inl and inr as lifts; S1852DoubledCone_lift_eval computes the canonical
   lift's 2-Yoneda evaluation as inl, S1852DoubledCone_inl_eq_inr turns essential
   surjectivity into inl = inr, and S1852Inl_ne_inr refutes that over the nonempty affine
   base. Hence S1852Doubled_not_coneEssSurj (general nonempty T),
   S1852DoubledIdentity_not_coneEssSurj, S1852Doubled_not_strong (no strong finite-etale
   structure forgets to S1850DoubledFiniteEtale), and S1852DoubledCover_not_coherent
   (S1850DoubledCover is not the underlying cover of any coherent cover).

HONEST BOUNDARIES (stated in the file header)
- No recorded definition was changed; S1728Cover still has not S1756FirstMissing. Coherent
  covers are a strictly smaller datum, and they are shown NOT to exhaust the covers only in
  the sense that no converse is claimed: proved is S1852FirstMissing_of_coherentAll
  ((forall A, exists coherent C with C.cover = A) -> S1756FirstMissing); the converse
  (strong presentations at all test points from the identity-point unit) is NOT claimed.
- No Category instance on the coherent covers is constructed (the recorded Category on
  S1728Cover is a 2-iso quotient); CoherentCover is a structure type with forgetful cover.

NOT DONE (left to coordinator): coord/STATE.md + coord/queue.md + AUDIT_LEDGER.md entries,
dag node update, and the S1852 report under coord/reports/. I did not touch shared coord
files to avoid clobbering concurrent owners. Scratch probe files deleted; only the deliverable
and _S1852ArtifactCheck.lean remain.

NEXT EXECUTABLE STEP (if wanted): (i) build a Category on the coherent covers whose homs are
the S1728 cover maps compatible with the strong presentations, and show the forgetful map is
full/faithful on 2-iso classes; or (ii) attack the converse of S1852FirstMissing_of_coherentAll
via base-change presentations at other scheme points + A.source.isStack (S1827 reports item (i))
to try to construct the strong structure from the identity-point unit.
